```sql
SELECT id, name FROM accounts WHERE region IS NULL OR launch_tier IS NULL LIMIT 5000;
```

sophie_ops: I'll schedule a resync at 09:30 PT and run dry-run first. tagging plan: fill region from billing_country mapping, default launch_tier='trial-self-serve' if unknown.
